xml_structure: <e-flexbox configuration-id="CTA band"><e-div-block configuration-id="CTA ring outer"></e-div-block><e-div-block configuration-id="CTA ring inner"></e-div-block><e-flexbox configuration-id="CTA content"><e-flexbox configuration-id="CTA label row"><e-div-block configuration-id="CTA rule"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="CTA label"></e-paragraph><e-div-block configuration-id="CTA rule 2"></e-div-block></e-flexbox><e-heading configuration-id="CTA title"></e-heading><e-paragraph configuration-id="CTA lead"></e-paragraph><e-flexbox configuration-id="CTA buttons"><e-button configuration-id="CTA quote"></e-button><e-button configuration-id="CTA call"></e-button></e-flexbox></e-flexbox></e-flexbox>

CTA title.title: Let’s build your next opening together.

CTA lead.paragraph: Tell us about your venue and we will curate the right products, brands and quantities — from a single outlet to a full hotel opening.

style.CTA band: min-height: 560px; padding: 107px 100px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; background-color: #071F44; background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(7,31,68,0.84), rgba(7,31,68,0.84)), url(https://soharon.co.uk/onora/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/about-cta-bg.jpg); background-size: cover; background-position: center center; background-repeat: no-repeat; @media(--tablet){ padding: 96px 40px; min-height: 0px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 72px 20px; min-height: 0px; }
style.CTA ring outer: position: absolute; top: -100px; left: 50%; margin-left: -380px; width: 760px; height: 760px; min-width: 760px; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1.2px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.3); z-index: 0;
style.CTA ring inner: position: absolute; top: 0px; left: 50%; margin-left: -280px; width: 560px; height: 560px; min-width: 560px; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.18); z-index: 0;
style.CTA content: flex-direction: column; gap: 26px; padding: 0px; width: 900px; max-width: 100%; align-items: center; z-index: 1;
style.CTA label row: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
style.CTA rule: width: 32px; min-width: 32px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.CTA label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-gold-soft); line-height: 1.2;
style.CTA rule 2: width: 32px; min-width: 32px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.CTA title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.3px; font-size: 68px; line-height: 70px; color: #FFFFFF; text-align: center; width: 860px; max-width: 100%; @media(--tablet){ font-size: 52px; line-height: 56px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 38px; line-height: 42px; }
style.CTA lead: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 17px; line-height: 29px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); text-align: center; width: 640px; max-width: 100%; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 15px; line-height: 26px; }
style.CTA buttons: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 16px; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; width: 100%; }
